  </g>

  <!-- axes through the origin (230, 400) -->
  <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
    <line x1="70" y1="400" x2="530" y2="400"/>
    <line x1="230" y1="25" x2="230" y2="705"/>
  </g>
  <polygon points="530,400 521,395 521,405" fill="#000000"/>
  <polygon points="230,25 225,35 235,35" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- tick marks -->
  <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="90" y1="395" x2="90" y2="405"/>
    <line x1="160" y1="395" x2="160" y2="405"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="395" x2="300" y2="405"/>
    <line x1="370" y1="395" x2="370" y2="405"/>

    <line x1="510" y1="395" x2="510" y2="405"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="50" x2="235" y2="50"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="120" x2="235" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="190" x2="235" y2="190"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="260" x2="235" y2="260"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="330" x2="235" y2="330"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="470" x2="235" y2="470"/>

    <line x1="225" y1="610" x2="235" y2="610"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="680" x2="235" y2="680"/>
  </g>

  <!-- curve y = x^2 - 2x - 3 for -2 <= x <= 4: a single exact quadratic Bezier -->
  <path d="M 90 50 Q 300 1310 510 50" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- x-axis numbers -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="17" fill="#000000">
    <text x="90" y="424" text-anchor="middle">-2</text>
    <text x="168" y="390" text-anchor="start">-1</text>
    <text x="300" y="424" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
    <text x="370" y="424" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
    <text x="432" y="390" text-anchor="end">3</text>
    <text x="510" y="424" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
    <text x="222" y="424" text-anchor="end">0</text>
  </g>

  <!-- y-axis numbers -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="17" fill="#000000">
    <text x="220" y="56" text-anchor="end">5</text>
    <text x="220" y="126" text-anchor="end">4</text>
    <text x="220" y="196" text-anchor="end">3</text>
    <text x="220" y="266" text-anchor="end">2</text>
    <text x="220" y="336" text-anchor="end">1</text>
    <text x="220" y="476" text-anchor="end">-1</text>
    <text x="240" y="546" text-anchor="start">-2</text>
    <text x="220" y="616" text-anchor="end">-3</text>
    <text x="220" y="686" text-anchor="end">-4</text>
  </g>

  <!-- axis names -->
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="19" fill="#000000">
    <text x="542" y="396" text-anchor="start">x</text>
    <text x="244" y="32" text-anchor="start">y</text>
  </g>

  <!-- equation label on a white box, so grid lines do not cross the text -->
  <rect x="296" y="94" width="178" height="26" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="304" y="113" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="18" fill="#000000">y = x² − 2x − 3</text>
</svg>
